biography: Gabriel Reis, a São Paulo native, tasted the adrenaline of motorsport early, tearing through the favelas on souped-up mopeds before his teens. His raw talent was undeniable, catching the eye of a local karting team owner who saw something special in the boy's fearless aggression. Reis quickly rose through the karting ranks, his elbows-out style earning him both wins and a reputation. A defining moment came at the Brazilian Karting Championship when, despite starting last due to a technical infraction, he carved his way through the field to victory, showcasing his relentless spirit. After a stint in Formula Brazil, marked by spectacular overtakes and occasional crashes, Reis now finds himself at the peak of his career, a midfield contender hungry for a breakthrough that will propel him to the top.
drivingStyle: Reis is an aggressively opportunistic driver, known for his late-braking maneuvers and willingness to take risks. He thrives under pressure, often finding an extra gear when the stakes are highest. While his raw speed is undeniable, tire management has been a persistent challenge. He tends to overdrive the car early in stints, sacrificing long-term pace for immediate gains. His corner entry is where he shines, often throwing the car into turns with remarkable precision and commitment.

careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the Brazilian Grand Prix in 2021 due to a mechanical failure with only two laps remaining, robbing him of a potential home victory.
